course_name_original: Fwp 4: Ki In I Ndustrie Oder Ki In Dienstleistungswirts Chaft
course_name_en: Elective 4: AI in Industry or AI in Service Economy

learning_outcomes.text: Students should acquire in-depth competencies in certain application areas of AI. This includes 2 SWS in Industry 4.0 and 2 SWS in the service economy (Service 4.0), which in SS 2021 are divided into 1 SWS Education 4.0 and 1 SWS overview of 4.0 in various service sectors such as E-Commerce 4.0, Logistics 4.0.
The module allows for individual specialization depending on the current economic situation.
Subject-specific and methodological competencies, as well as social and personal competencies, are emphasized differently depending on the content offered.

assessment_rules: The module examination is a written test lasting 90 minutes. The weighting of the grade is 5/210.
